{{Top|leg}}
The '''mumau root''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]. The plant was found on the higher levels of Volik's [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and was most common on [[Mount Vorena]], the world's highest peak. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorin Se'ol]] claimed that [[Tea/Legends|tea]] made from the mumau root could aid [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]], although whether his claim was true was considered debatable.
